text:
maria_cs: Kicking off a quick sandbox cleanse — ran a query and found ~2k stale trial accounts with no activity in 90d. Planning a dry-run + sample review before applying playbook to any production sets. tagging eng and ops for safety.

jon_eng: quick q — are these in the staging mirror or a slice of prod? we should always run on the staging mirror first.

maria_cs: staging mirror (cs-sandbox-db). I'll generate a sampled export and put it in S3 for review: s3://redwood-cs/sandbox-cleanses/1753219876/sample.csv

sam_ops: FYI our playbook runner supports prereq checks. I can add a webhook ack gate so the automation won't touch anything unless ops confirms.

maria_cs: please add that prereq. we also need idempotency — last time duplicate nudges went out when the runner retried.

jon_eng: adding flags to the runner, example for the dry-run: 
```
redwood-playbook run --env sandbox --playbook crm-cleanse --dry-run --idempotent
```

sam_ops: good. for sampling set sample_rate=0.02 to keep a small, reviewable set (~2%). we can ramp to 0.1 after signoff.

maria_cs: timeline: sample run today, internal review tomorrow, schedule limited apply on Wed if sample looks clean.

lee_cs: I'll prep owner nudge templates and the short feedback capture form for affected owners: https://forms.redwood.com/cs/cleanse-feedback — will include quick buttons (keep/claim/archive).

marta_pm: can we ensure all changes are appended to an audit table? we need uid, previous_owner, new_owner, changed_by, reason, and a trace id.

jon_eng: yes — automation will write to cs_audit.changes with those columns. for dry-run I'll write to cs_audit.dryrun_traces instead so nothing touches the live audit until we flip the flag.

sam_ops: post-run smoke test: I will sample 50 accounts from the output and validate healthscore delta < 0.05 and that onboarding status didn't regress. If any fail, we halt.

maria_cs: perfect. @jon_eng @sam_ops @lee_cs I'll upload the sample CSV when ready and ping for a quick sync. :thumbsup:

bot-cleaner: Reminder — dry-run scheduled to finish in ~2h. I will post results and attach the trace log when done.

lee_cs: noted — I'll prepare enablement notes + owner handoff checklist in the playbook doc.

maria_cs: thanks all — keeping this scoped and reversible. will update the playbook doc with the exact CLI flags and the audit table schema: https://docs.redwood.com/cs/cleanse-playbook-sandbox

(reacts: maria_cs :thumbsup:, jon_eng :white_check_mark:)
